AI inspection of solar plants

04Shading: vegetation and structures covering the modules.

Autosteering for farm machinery

01Accuracy down to ±2.5 cm: minimal overlaps and skips between passes.
02Any speed: stable operation from 0.1 to 30 km/h.
03Versatility: tractors, sprayers and seeders.
